excerpt: If we offer agreements with a non-disparagement clause, that clause will not preclude raising safety concerns, nor will it preclude disclosure of the existence of that clause.
paraphrase: Any non-disparagement clause offered will still permit raising safety concerns and disclosing the clause's existence.

excerpt: Internal review: We will regularly conduct an internal review of our implementation of this policy.
paraphrase: Anthropic commits to conducting regular internal reviews of policy implementation.

excerpt: Procedural compliance review: On approximately an annual basis, we will commission a third-party review that assesses whether we adhered to this policy's main procedural commitments.
paraphrase: Anthropic will commission an approximately annual third-party review of adherence to the policy's procedural commitments.

excerpt: This review will focus on procedural compliance, not substantive outcomes.
paraphrase: The third-party review is scoped to procedure rather than outcomes.

excerpt: Policy changes: Changes to the RSP will be proposed by the CEO and RSO, and approved by the Board in consultation with the LTBT.
paraphrase: RSP changes are proposed by the CEO and RSO and approved by the Board with LTBT consultation.

excerpt: If we update the RSP, we will publicly share the updated version prior to or on its effective date and will record the differences from the prior draft in the Change Log.
paraphrase: Updates to the RSP will be published by their effective date, with changes documented in a Change Log.

excerpt: We will maintain the current version of the RSP on our website.
paraphrase: The current RSP will always be posted on Anthropic's website.

section_heading: Appendix A: Commitments Related to Competitors
excerpt: These commitments are necessarily high-level and limited. In many cases, we will not have enough information to determine that the relevant scenario applies and will have to use our best judgment to deal with uncertainty.
paraphrase: Anthropic acknowledges these competitor-related commitments are broad and will require judgment amid uncertain information.

section_heading: Appendix A: Commitments Related to Competitors
excerpt: But to the extent that other relevant AI developers prioritize safety and invest in legible demonstrations that they are doing so—as we intend to—commitments like this may help avoid an inadvertent "race to the bottom" on safety.
paraphrase: If other AI developers similarly prioritize and demonstrate safety, such commitments may help prevent a safety race to the bottom.
